title: Do Not Fear
verse: But Jesus, paying no attention to what was said, told the synagogue leader, “Do not be afraid; just believe.
observation: This phrase by Jesus always makes me smile. Mainly because I think it sounds so hard to do, but Jesus asks for it anyway. Have you ever tried not to be afraid of something when you're in the middle of it? It's freakin' hard. lol. However, Jesus often asks us to do hard things while He does impossible things.
application: Today, I'm going to look at every fear and smile. The King is moving.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being bigger than our biggest fears.
